description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS carries a VIEW column's NOT NULL, on the same rule DESCRIBE VIEW's null? cell uses: a projected column reference keeps it, an expression over that same column loses it, and an outer join clears it on the side it null-extends and only that side. Live-verified against the base table as a control - the two surfaces agree row for row, in this view's spelling (YES/NO) rather than DESCRIBE's (Y/N). Converted 1:1 from features/ViewColumnIsNullableTest (now retired); its setupTest fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE vn_t (k NUMBER NOT NULL, v VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, w VARCHAR(4))
SELECT column_name, is_nullable FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'VN_T' ORDER BY column_name
CREATE TABLE vn_t (k NUMBER NOT NULL, v VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, w VARCHAR(4))
CREATE VIEW vn_v AS SELECT k, v, w FROM vn_t
SELECT column_name, is_nullable FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'VN_V' ORDER BY column_name
CREATE TABLE vn_t (k NUMBER NOT NULL, v VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, w VARCHAR(4))
CREATE VIEW vn_e AS SELECT UPPER(v) AS uv, v || 'x' AS cv FROM vn_t
SELECT column_name, is_nullable FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'VN_E' ORDER BY column_name
CREATE TABLE vn_t (k NUMBER NOT NULL, v VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, w VARCHAR(4))
CREATE TABLE vn_r (k NUMBER NOT NULL, r VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL)
CREATE VIEW vn_j AS SELECT l.v AS lv, r.r AS rr FROM vn_t l LEFT JOIN vn_r r ON l.k = r.k
SELECT column_name, is_nullable FROM test_db.information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'VN_J' ORDER BY column_name
